backend/main.mo: Defines the backend canister actor with authorization and blob‑storage mixins plus all core types for users, rituals, pairing, analytics, love languages, and challenges.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, related files, components, and test IDs with confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of key frontend files describing functionality, design tokens, UI behaviors, and logic across the app.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind‑based OKLCH color system and theme variables for light/dark modes with base styling rules.
frontend/index.html: Static HTML entry point defining metadata, viewport settings, theme color, and mounting root for the frontend app.
frontend/QA_ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md: Manual QA checklist detailing step‑by‑step tests for authentication, setup, pairing, rituals, UI polish, and feature behaviors.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app shell controlling theme, authentication, profile setup, landing‑vs‑app mode, and tab navigation.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Renders a bottom navigation bar with icons and labels, highlighting the active tab and handling tab changes.
frontend/src/components/CompletionAnimat: Displays floating animated heart icons using randomized positions and delays for a completion effect.
frontend/src/components/DataStates.tsx: Provides reusable UI components for loading, empty, error, section header, and inline loading states.
frontend/src/components/HarmonyBreakdown: Shows current harmony score, trend visualization, and explanatory details with a 7‑day sparkline if enough data exists.
Displays a compact harmony summary button showing percentage and trend, navigating to insights when pressed.
frontend/src/components/LandingFooterLin: Renders a modal dialog with static informational content for footer links like contact, terms, privacy, and investor info.
frontend/src/components/LandingScreensho: Implements a swipeable and clickable screenshot carousel with touch and mouse gesture support.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Handles Internet Identity login/logout states and renders a button that adapts to authentication and loading status.
frontend/src/components/LoveChallenges.t: Displays a card announcing that love challenges are coming soon with decorative icons.
frontend/src/components/OurLoveLanguages: Renders an interactive card showing love language status, a primary action button, and a shortcut to insights.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Provides a profile setup form that captures a user's name, initializes their profile, and handles loading and success states.
frontend/src/components/RewardVisuals.ts: Shows placeholder progress and milestone visuals for a love‑themed progress tracker using hearts and icons.
frontend/src/components/SpinWheel.tsx: Implements a spin‑the‑wheel selector for love languages with animations, daily spin limits, and result persistence.
frontend/src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx: A button that toggles between light and dark themes using the app’s theme hook.
frontend/src/components/UnlockPacks.tsx: Displays unlockable activity packs based on love languages and streak requirements, with UI for viewing pack details.
frontend/src/content/founderStory.ts: Exports a narrative describing the origin story and inspiration behind the Grow In Love app.
frontend/src/contexts/ThemeContext.tsx: Provides a theme context with light/dark/system modes, syncing effective theme to the DOM and localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity, invalidating dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication context, managing login, stored identities, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Wraps backend calls in React Query hooks for profiles, admin checks, ritual data, and related mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Re-exports the useTheme hook for compatibility.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom light/dark theme variables with animations and UI utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers.
frontend/src/pages/Activities.tsx: Renders the Activities page, gating content by authentication, pairing, and admin status and showing activity components.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Main daily ritual page handling prompts, responses, uploads, history, and completion flow.
frontend/src/pages/Insights.tsx: Displays streaks, harmony scores, trends, badges, and quiz alignment insights based on backend data.
frontend/src/pages/Landing.tsx: Public landing page with marketing content, hero section, feature highlights, and entry/login controls.
frontend/src/pages/LoveLanguages.tsx: Love Languages quiz page for answering questions, calculating scores, and saving or resetting quiz results.
frontend/src/pages/Memories.tsx: Shows past ritual entries with dates, prompts, responses, and optional photos in an expandable list.
frontend/src/pages/Us.tsx: React page handling user pairing, profile checks, and partner-related UI state, with hooks for identity and quiz data.
frontend/src/utils/harmony.ts: Utility functions for harmony percentages, trend normalization, and generating trend display metadata.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for manipulating URL hash-based app mode and reading secret query parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS configuration extending theme colors, fonts, animations, and enabling plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state descriptor outlining landing page goals, requirements, assets, and known issues.
